title: 雨落在第七码头
timeWindow: forty days, centered on one typhoon night

checks: the 412 cloud shadows, glass beads and commercial weather orders resolve into one evidence chain
the seven-minute protocol pays off without turning Shen Bozhou into an uncomplicated hero
technical exposition is converted into visible objects, timed decisions and public measurements
the climax distributes risk instead of inventing a consequence-free shutdown
the ending preserves institutional uncertainty while completing Shen Yao's personal change
